result.rationale: refreshOAuthTokens (new in diff) returns the raw fetch Response when credential sync is enabled (`const response = await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...); return response;`), whereas the callback returns `fetchTokens.res` (gaxios response with .data). In googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts, the wrapped code then does `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token;` — a fetch Response has no .data property, so token is undefined and token.access_token throws. Mechanism is verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: When CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is configured, refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response, but this code reads res?.data expecting the gaxios token body that myGoogleAuth.refreshToken previously returned. A fetch Response has no .data property, so token is undefined and token.access_token on line 95 throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined — the Google Calendar refresh path crashes on every credential-sync-enabled instance instead of fetching tokens.
